name: Sitcom: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark
